detail.title: SA80DBFG | 8 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine (Black & Orange)
detail.overview: Designed for efficiency, the SA80DBFG 8 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine combines power and convenience. With a robust motor, Roller Jet Pulsator, and Dual Level Waterfall, it ensures deep cleaning while protecting fabrics. The Magic Filter removes lint, and the Noise-Free Spinning delivers a peaceful experience. A rust-free body, Water Level Adjuster, and Hydraulic Wash Lid make it a reliable choice for every household.
features: Anti-Corrosive Rust-Free Body for long-lasting durability
Roller Jet with Mini Pulsator Design for powerful wash action
Dual Level Waterfall Technology for better detergent mixing
Magic Filter to trap lint and prevent clogging
Hydraulic Wash Lid for smooth and effortless operation
Powerful Motor with TOP Technology for deep cleaning
Noise-Free Spinning for a peaceful washing experience
Water Level Adjuster for optimized water usage
